title: Voice typing — the simpler warning line

steps.path: The band above the message box while the mic is on
steps.headline: The amber band is now one line: "No sound detected — device may be muted".
steps.changed: From your note on the last page: the second line of advice is gone. The card after you stop still gives the fuller advice.
steps.measured: 3 seconds of silence before it warns
steps.notice: A muted mic is caught while you are still talking, instead of after you stop. It turns green again the moment any sound arrives.
steps.risk: Only fires on true silence. A working mic in a quiet room still sends faint hiss, so a normal pause should never trigger it.

variants.label: Before
variants.summary: Today: green Listening even when the mic sends nothing.

variants.summary: One amber line after 3 seconds of pure silence.
